name: The majority voted in favour of a motion: > *That so much of standing orders be suspended as would prevent the motion for the third reading being moved without delay.* Standing orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament. This means the House will now vote right away on [whether to read the bill for a third time](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/representatives/2024-11-28/12) (parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill).
